title: Structural Basis for TRF2-RAP1 Recruitment by EBNA1 at the EBV origin of replication.
authors: Lieberman, Paul; Sustek, Samantha; Messick, Troy; Dheekollu, Jayaraju; Albitz, Coltin; Chen, Christopher; Faustino, Anneliese; Tang, Hsin-Yao; Kim, Hee Jong; Murakami, Kenji
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜、交联质谱和AlphaFold3建模解析EBNA1-TRF2-RAP1在EBV复制起点上的蛋白-DNA复合物结构，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构建模研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面分析。
abstract: Epstein-Barr Nuclear Antigen 1 (EBNA1) is essential for the episomal maintenance and DNA replication of Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) in latently infected cells and acts through binding to oriP. The minimal replicative unit of oriP ((1/2)DS) contains four EBNA1 binding sites flanked by single telomeric nonamers that recruit shelterin proteins TRF2 and Rap1, but the structural basis for host-factor engagement is not known. Here, we integrate cryo-electron microscopy, zero-length cross-linking mass spectrometry, Alphafold3 modeling, and biochemical binding assays to define the complex formed by EBNA1-TRF2-Rap1 assembly on the (1/2)DS. We find that a highly dynamic complex is formed, with the TRF2 homodimerization domain (TRFH) flexibly interacting with EBNA1 on the surface opposite the DNA-binding region, where there is a large acidic patch in EBNA1 that is unique amongst the herpesvirus episome maintenance proteins. Mutagenesis of this acidic patch abolishes TRFH binding and oriP-dependent plasmid replication. These findings identify a previously uncharacterized acidic patch docking surface on EBNA1 essential for coordinating TRF2-RAP1 at oriP and provide new insights into both EBV and telomere DNA replication.
abstract_zh: Epstein-Barr核抗原1（EBNA1）对于Epstein-Barr病毒（EBV）在潜伏感染细胞中的附加体维持和DNA复制至关重要，并通过结合oriP发挥作用。oriP的最小复制单位（(1/2)DS）包含四个EBNA1结合位点，两侧由单个端粒非amer序列包围，这些序列招募shelterin蛋白TRF2和Rap1，但宿主因子参与的结构基础尚不清楚。在此，我们整合冷冻电子显微镜、零长度交联质谱、Alphafold3建模和生化结合实验，以定义EBNA1-TRF2-Rap1在(1/2)DS上形成的复合物。我们发现形成了一个高度动态的复合物，其中TRF2同源二聚化结构域（TRFH）与EBNA1在DNA结合区域对面的表面柔性相互作用，该表面存在一个大的酸性补丁，这在疱疹病毒附加体维持蛋白中是独特的。该酸性补丁的突变消除了TRFH结合和oriP依赖性质粒复制。这些发现识别了EBNA1上一个先前未表征的酸性补丁对接表面，该表面对于在oriP处协调TRF2-RAP1至关重要，并为EBV和端粒DNA复制提供了新见解。
